Create a game sprite animation sheet with EXACTLY NINE isolated FULL BODY paintings arranged in THREE ROWS and THREE COLUMNS. Input is the identity reference for AshenSpire reaver. Match its exact armor/robe motif, colors, headwear, cape shape, proportions and faceted painted finish. Background solid uniform bright MAGENTA #ff00ff for chroma key extraction; no shadow, gradient, checkerboard or text. ROW ONE: SHIELD GUARD three sequential frames: shield raised from waist; brace behind shield; defensive held shield stance.

Use a steel kite shield with gold edging in shield rows; keep main hand one-handed sword lowered throughout. Closed helmet and this exact armor and cape.
Offhand has shield in rows one and three, dagger ONLY in row two. No extra arms or weapons. Real clearly different articulated poses, shield visibly moves between bash windup impact recovery. Medium full body figures, same head size every cell. This is raster artwork to be sliced for actual animation, not an infographic.
